features: Sleek Design and Fits Comfortably Anywhere
Supports Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Mac OS 10.3 or later and Chrome OS
description: Elevate your creativity with the improved precision of the HP Tilt Pen. Write, draw, and compute as naturally as ever with true-to-life feel creating a seamless and enjoyable working experience. Tilt. Shade. Create. Feels as natural as putting pen to paper with tilt for improved precision and pressure detection for shading at different angles, giving you a true-to-life drawing experience. Integrated presenter controls Activate presentation mode to conveniently move your cursor, flip through slides, and highlight key points of your presentation-without the need for a clicker. Long Battery life With a long battery life of up to 18 months, you can simply focus on your work instead of frequently recharging the pen.
